stories.title: Le Pape Léon XIV attendu à Metz, après sa visite à Paris et Lourdes

en.title: Pope Leo XIV expected in Metz after visits to Paris and Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV will travel to Metz on Monday morning for the final stage of his visit to France, which will have a more European and interreligious focus.

stories.title: "C'est un scandale sans nom" : Arnaud Gallais, victime de violences sexuelles, dénonce l'insuffisance de la prise en compte de ce fléau dans l'Eglise par le pape Léon XIV

en.title: "It is an unprecedented scandal": Arnaud Gallais, victim of sexual violence, denounces the Pope Leo XIV's insufficient response to abuse in the Church
en.summary: The president of advocacy group Mouv'Enfants criticizes the Church for what he describes as serious crimes and expresses dissatisfaction with a meeting between the Pope and seven abuse survivors.

stories.title: Visite du pape à Lourdes : Léon XIV encourage l'Eglise de France à "poursuivre" son action face au "fléau" des violences sexuelles

en.title: Pope's visit to Lourdes: Leo XIV encourages the French Church to "continue" its action against the "scourge" of sexual violence
en.summary: During a large gathering at the Marian sanctuary, Pope Leo XIV addressed crowds of families, clergy, and pilgrims on the Church's ongoing efforts to combat sexual abuse.

stories.title: EN DIRECT - Léon XIV à Lourdes : le pape encourage l’Église de France à «poursuivre» son action face au «fléau» des violences sexuelles

en.title: LIVE - Leo XIV in Lourdes: the Pope encourages the French Church to "continue" its action against the "scourge" of sexual violence
en.summary: After drawing over one million people during two days in Paris, Pope Leo XIV continues his French visit in Lourdes with a mass and a highly anticipated meeting with abuse survivors.

stories.title: Le Pape face aux victimes d'abus sexuels à Lourdes après sa venue à Paris

en.title: Pope meets sexual abuse victims at Lourdes following Paris visit
en.summary: The Pope is meeting with victims of sexual abuse at Lourdes after his time in Paris. A representative from an abuse survivors' organization is being interviewed about the encounter.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : avez-vous été touché par les messages de Léon XIV à Paris et Lourdes ?

en.title: Pope's visit to France: were you moved by León XIV's messages in Paris and Lourdes?
en.summary: The Pope delivered messages during his visits to Paris and Lourdes in France, prompting reflection on their impact among the public.

stories.title: A Lourdes, Léon XIV dénonce le « douloureux fléau » des violences sexuelles et encourage l’Eglise catholique en France à « poursuivre » son action

en.title: In Lourdes, León XIV denounces the "painful scourge" of sexual violence and encourages the Catholic Church in France to "continue" its action
en.summary: The Pope addressed sexual violence as a serious issue in Lourdes and called on the French Catholic Church to maintain its response efforts. He is scheduled to meet privately with seven victims before presiding over a mass.

stories.title: "On minimise la dimension systémique" : pourquoi la rencontre du pape Léon XIV avec sept victimes de violences sexuelles provoque des crispations

en.title: "The systemic dimension is being downplayed": why Pope León XIV's meeting with seven sexual violence victims is causing tensions
en.summary: During his France visit, the Pope is meeting with several people who experienced sexual abuse within the Church at Lourdes. Some advocacy groups have expressed concerns about the format selected for this encounter.

stories.title: Visite du pape en France : bain de foule, pèlerins malades et victimes de violences sexuelles au programme de Léon XIV

en.title: Pope's visit to France: crowds, sick pilgrims and sexual abuse victims on Leo XIV's schedule
en.summary: The Pope continues his French visit with a Sunday in Lourdes, where he will meet seven victims of sexual abuse within the Church, an encounter expected to draw significant scrutiny.

stories.title: À Lourdes, le pape Léon XIV face à la question des violences sexuelles dans l’Église catholique

en.title: In Lourdes, Pope Leo XIV faces the question of sexual abuse in the Catholic Church
en.summary: Following two days in Paris that drew over one million people, the Pope continues his French visit in Lourdes on Sunday with a new mass and a highly anticipated meeting with victims of sexual abuse in the Church.

stories.title: Léon XIV en France : la rencontre attendue mais contestée avec les victimes de violences sexuelles

en.title: Leo XIV in France: the anticipated yet contested meeting with sexual abuse victims
en.summary: Seven victims of sexual abuse in the Church, selected by Catholic authorities, met privately with the Pope in Lourdes on September 27, though the private format of the meeting raised questions despite signaling the pontiff's continued concern.

stories.title: Léon XIV en France : après Paris, le pape est arrivé à Lourdes

en.title: Leon XIV in France: after Paris, the pope arrives in Lourdes
en.summary: Pope Leon XIV, who arrived in France on Friday, is continuing his four-day visit to the country. Saturday's main event includes an outdoor mass in central Paris.

stories.title: Le grand retour de Sophie Adenot approche

en.title: Sophie Adenot's big return is approaching
en.summary: American astronaut Jessica Meir shared a photo on September 26 of the Crew 12 team testing their spacesuits in preparation for their return to Earth, marking the end of Sophie Adenot's epsilon mission.

stories.title: Carburant : l’aide aux pêcheurs entre en vigueur, mais l’automne reste en suspens

en.title: Fuel: aid to fishermen comes into force, but autumn remains uncertain
en.summary: A decree published on 27 September enables payments of 25 cents per liter of fuel purchased between June and August to fishermen. The retroactive assistance, funded with 18 million euros, aims to support cash flow following diesel price increases.

stories.title: OPINION. « Touche pas à mon asso », par Elsa Da Costa, Valérie Daher, Damien Baldin et 80 acteurs du monde associatif

en.title: OPINION. "Hands off my association", by Elsa Da Costa, Valérie Daher, Damien Baldin and 80 associates sector players
en.summary: Eighty association leaders, social entrepreneurs, and foundations have issued a call to protect economic and social heritage, supported by figures including François Hollande, François Ruffin, and Pascal Canfin.

stories.title: Angleterre : ce que l’on sait de l’alerte autour de la base américaine

en.title: England: what is known about the alert at the American military base
en.summary: Several individuals were arrested and residents evacuated near a British base used by the United States military. Authorities have described the incident as major.

stories.title: Visite de Léon XIV : Lourdes, passage obligé des papes

en.title: Visit of Pope Leo XIV: Lourdes, mandatory stop for popes
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV is making a pilgrimage to Lourdes, following previous papal visits by John Paul II and Benedict XVI. He had previously visited the site twice during his younger years.
